item.title: Introducing Julian Klausner, the Rising Star Behind Dries Van Noten
item.description: In just a year, Julian Klausner has gone from a complete unknown to an undeniable rising star. VF meets the 34 year old Belgian ahead of his fifth show for Dries Van Noten at Paris Fashion Week.

item.title: The Whirlwind Voyage of Demi Moore’s Schiaparelli Couture Gown
item.description: From Paris to Milan and finally Los Angeles, discover the epic journey of Demi Moore’s Schiaparelli couture look and how it made its way to the 2026 Actor Awards red carpet.

item.title: The Water Polo Scandal That Rocked LA’s Most Elite Private School
item.description: In 2024 top water polo player Lucca van der Woude was arrested at Los Angeles’s Harvard-Westlake School—allegedly under suspicion of sexual assault. The criminal case against the player was closed, and the elite academy maintains it did nothing wrong. But a new civil suit accuses the school of risking the safety of two students of color—while allegedly protecting the white teammate who made their lives unbearable.

item.title: The TikTokers Reading the Epstein Files So You Don’t Have To
item.description: How TikTok turned a massive government document dump into a crowdsourced investigation.

item.title: She Got Fired for Reposting Charlie Kirk Criticism. Months Later, She’s Still Suffering
item.description: Public mourning for the slain founder of Turning Point USA ended quickly, but for those who were fired in the wake of his death, the damage is lasting. Lauren Stokes speaks to Vanity Fair about her lawsuit against the University of Mississippi.

item.title: Jack Schlossberg Says Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette is “Capital F for Fiction”
item.description: Ryan Murphy’s new series is drawing the ire of the Schlossberg, a political candidate and scion of the Kennedy clan.

item.title: Megan Moroney Is an “Emo Cowgirl” With Big Ambition
item.description: The country singer-songwriter on her pink and tiger-print era, the singer she idolizes, and her much-discussed friendship with Morgan Wallen.

item.title: Daniel Radcliffe Loves Playing a Neurotic Creative—and Wants You to Join Him
item.description: The Tony winner on his audience-participation play Every Brilliant Thing, sharing Broadway with his Harry Potter pal Tom Felton, and why he’s done talking about J.K. Rowling.

item.title: Before Celebrities Die, They Share Their Famous Last Words With Brad Falchuk on Netflix
item.description: “I get to hear all this great wisdom and humanity, and I really want everyone else to hear it—but I never want anyone else to hear it,” the TV creator turned first-time host tells Vanity Fair about his groundbreaking new interview format.

item.title: Actually, Fashion Week Has Always Been a Billionaire’s Playground
item.description: Read José Criales-Unzueta’s column on style and fashion that will examine its intersections with power, culture, and society.
